title: Introducing Haladir Hawkeye: Mapping American Ground Logistics
summary: Haladir Hawkeye is a free, live map of more than 74,000 American warehouses, truck terminals, wholesale centers and parcel hubs, and the conditions around them.
body_markdown:
We mapped more than 74,000 warehouses, truck terminals, wholesale centers and parcel hubs across the lower 48 states, sites that together employ 6.4 million American workers. Today we are releasing that map as Haladir Hawkeye: a free, live operating picture of American ground logistics, open to anyone at[hawkeye.haladir.com](https://hawkeye.haladir.com/) .


Hawkeye was inspired by Flexport Atlas, but its focus is domestic inland operations. It shows each site alongside what is happening around it now, including traffic and road closures, border waits, blocked rail crossings, cargo flights, ships, river locks and weather. Then it connects the two. When a storm warning is issued, a lock closes or a border crossing backs up, Hawkeye says which sites are affected and how many, and it keeps that picture current through the day.


Live conditions are only part of the picture. From our work with operators, we know safety is their number one priority, and that they often lack the site-level data they need to act on it. So each site on the map also has a safety profile. It draws on public federal records, including OSHA injury reports and inspections, and shows how the site compares with similar ones. The records are shown as they were filed, so some will be wrong, and Hawkeye lists every source it draws on.


Why build this? At Haladir, we develop advanced AI decision systems that run inside major logistics operations, and we have noticed how unevenly this kind of supply chain intelligence is shared with the general public. Hawkeye opens it to everyone: operators can see the conditions affecting their sites, and American workers can see the safety records of the places where they work.


Haladir Hawkeye is free to use. Visit it at[hawkeye.haladir.com](https://hawkeye.haladir.com/) .


Read the[launch announcement on X](https://x.com/thehutchmann/status/2123504702591836498) .
